create_secret_aws: create a secret in AWS Secrets Manager with a name, value, and optional tags
get_secret_aws: get a secret from AWS Secrets Manager by its ID or ARN
delete_secret_aws: delete a secret from AWS Secrets Manager by its ID
create_secret_async_aws: create a secret in AWS Secrets Manager asynchronously with a name and value
get_secret_async_aws: get a secret from AWS Secrets Manager asynchronously by its ID
